name: directional-punch-controls
description: Verify independent up/down punch controls, one-second attack cadence, character action motion, and non-overlapping action UI.

args.code: local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] a:Invoke('Reset') a:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=250,WallLevel=99}) local hrp=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') hrp.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-27),Vector3.new(-2,3,-80)) return 'POSITIONED'

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local up=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchDirection') task.wait(.75) local hrp=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart hrp.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-27),Vector3.new(-2,3,-80)) return H:JSONEncode({ok=up=='Up',direction=up,interval=workspace.PunchWallRPG:GetAttribute('PunchAttackInterval')})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local h=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD
local function effectivelyVisible(object)
 local current=object
 while current and current~=g do
  if current:IsA('GuiObject') and not current.Visible then return false end
  current=current.Parent
 end
 return current==g and g.Enabled
end
local function rect(object)
 if not object then return {exists=false} end
 local pos,size=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
 return {exists=true,x=pos.X,y=pos.Y,w=size.X,h=size.Y,active=object.Active,visible=object.Visible,effectiveVisible=effectivelyVisible(object),profile=object:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile')}
end
local function overlap(a,b)
 return a.exists and b.exists and a.x<b.x+b.w and a.x+a.w>b.x and a.y<b.y+b.h and a.y+a.h>b.y
end
local up=h:FindFirstChild('PunchUp') local down=h:FindFirstChild('PunchDown') local nextCard=h:FindFirstChild('NextWorldCard')
local a,b,n=rect(up),rect(down),rect(nextCard)
local count=g:GetAttribute('CharacterPunchCount') or 0
local upNext,downNext=overlap(a,n),overlap(b,n)
local upDown=overlap(a,b)
local ok=a.exists and b.exists and n.exists and a.active and b.active and a.effectiveVisible and b.effectiveVisible
 and not upDown and (not n.effectiveVisible or (not upNext and not downNext)) and count>=2
local result={ok=ok,count=count,upDirection=up and up:GetAttribute('PunchDirection'),downDirection=down and down:GetAttribute('PunchDirection'),
 up=a,down=b,next=n,upDownOverlap=upDown,rawUpNextOverlap=upNext,rawDownNextOverlap=downNext,
 visibleUpNextOverlap=n.effectiveVisible and upNext or false,visibleDownNextOverlap=n.effectiveVisible and downNext or false,
 camera={workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y},hud={h.AbsoluteSize.X,h.AbsoluteSize.Y},
 responsiveProfile=g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile'),touch=game:GetService('UserInputService').TouchEnabled}
return H:JSONEncode(result)
